title: The Councillor
pitch: Councillor Vane took Victor's money and voted Varga's way. Get the money back, or her word for Thursday.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: A plastic wallet weighted under the fountain's lip. Cash, a thousand by the thickness. She hasn't spent a note of it.

clue_b.label: The black car by the house
lines: A typed list of council votes on the passenger seat. Hers is ticked. So is Thursday's. This car isn't hers.
